description: Implementation of Manufacturer Data Access Object (DAO) that interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations and queries related to 'Manufacturer' entities within a shopping context.

classes.name: ManufacturerDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for managing 'Manufacturer' entities, including methods for retrieving manufacturer data based on various criteria.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products associated with a given manufacturer.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a manufacturer by its unique identifier.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all manufacturers associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Returns a list of manufacturers linked to products within specific categories for a given store and language.
